title: Round 0 (patch 5): the illegal swap, Bejeweled style
why: Patch 4 made it worse on the live site. Players sit in the co-op room, where an illegal swap never moved and drew red brackets. Solo also crawled home. Full co-op receipts: tools/out/swap/index.html.
beforeLabel: patch 4 (solo path: hold, then a slow back-out)
afterLabel: patch 5: full swap, bump, swap back
changes: The pair swaps fully at normal swap speed, bumps into the wrong cell (squash, rattle, dust, reject sound) and swaps back on the same curve.
The same animation for solo, co-op host and co-op peer; visual only in co-op, so nothing goes over the network.
Red corner brackets and the No match toast are gone.
checks: swap-audit: solo, host and peer reach the other cell, the biggest per-frame jump is 0.12 to 0.19 cell (no teleports), all end home
no toast, no brackets, board hashes match, 0 errors

title: Round 1 (patch 6): the combo ladder, x5 is a concert
why: Andre: combos need to feel like 'ooh yes I got a freaking 5x combo!'. In the baseline, x3, x5 and x9 looked about the same (a sky tint, some rings, a small side plaque). Direction: MORE; x1 keeps its flash, and every tier stacks a new kind of response on top.
changes: x3+: a centre-stage callout that slams in and grows each tier: SPARKLING, RADIANT, DAZZLING, BRILLIANT, PRISMATIC, LEGENDARY, TRANSCENDENT (rainbow).
x3+: a synthesized chord sting that climbs two semitones per tier; x4+ adds a sub boom.
x5+: nightclub lasers: 12 rainbow beams sweep up from the horizon behind the cabinet and hold while the chain lives.
x5+: tapered anime speed lines around the board, plus a hard 160 ms strobe in the tier colour (skipped with reduced motion).
checks: WebGL2 fallback renders the lasers, 0 errors
nine-wave fixture reaches x9 with 0 errors on both builds

title: Round 2 (patch 7): Resonance music, a soundtrack that plays along
why: Andre: 'next up is ambient music'. The drop had no music unless you loaded your own file. Tetris Effect's trick is that the music layers in with your play.
beforeLabel: patch 6 (no music; the clip is silent)
afterLabel: patch 7 with the music the engine schedules for this exact run (turn the sound on)
changes: A generative, sample-free soundtrack on the music bus (the Music volume slider controls it), in your Gem tones key (natural minor), at 84 BPM.

Pad always on (chord every 2 bars: i VI III VII, then i iv VI VII). Bass joins as the board warms up, 16th arps through a tempo-synced echo as flow rises, then kick, hats and clap when the board is hot or a chain hits x4. A pentatonic lead plays while the x5 sky lasers are on.
Loading your own track silences it; removing the track brings it back. Mute works as before.
audio: 60 s journey render: calm, warming up, hot, a x5 chain with lasers (30 to 42 s), cooling down
images: Spectrogram of the journey: the pad from 0 s, the arp around 17 s, drums (vertical hat lines) from 23 s, the lead in the laser window, fading back after
checks: offline render uses the real in-page scheduler (OfflineAudioContext): 558 notes in 60 s, 0 errors
live path: after one real click the realtime scheduler is producing notes (pad level 0.64 at 2.5 s)
not verified by ear: I cannot listen, so the musical taste is Tront's call
